name: Phone Feature Tabs
summary: An expandable list of capabilities (plus icon, active row grows with a description) synced to a carousel of phone screens with prev/next chevrons; FLIP row transitions, sliding phone poses with a peeking rear phone, and a chip, expand and summary layout on narrow screens.
useWhen: A product page shows several capabilities, each with its own app screen
Phone screens should be real React content rather than screenshots
avoidWhen: Only one screenshot is needed; use a plain phone mockup
Content is long-form documentation rather than short capability blurbs
